title: Monthly pricing: ¥29 / ¥89 / ¥199
body: 29,000 / 89,000 / 199,000 regular points for a one-month term. Entry: selected stable models, docs and FAQs, standard support. Standard: stabilized new models, integration assistance, priority support. Pro: early model access, complex integration assistance, high-priority support. Monthly and yearly plans have the same tier benefits.

title: Yearly pricing: ¥290 / ¥890 / ¥1,990
body: 348,000 / 1,068,000 / 2,388,000 regular points for 12 months; save two months compared with monthly purchases. All points are credited after payment.

title: Purchase options: one-time or auto renewal
body: The same tier and cycle have the same price. A one-time purchase does not create an authorization or cancel an existing matching authorization.

title: Auto renewal: scheduled charges after authorization
body: Renewals use the confirmed tier, cycle and payment method. Authorizing an already purchased plan does not immediately charge or credit points.

title: 10% bonus: only after successful auto renewal
body: The bonus is based on regular points for the same tier and cycle. Initial purchases, authorization alone and failed payments receive no bonus.

title: Cancel auto renewal: stops future charges only
body: Cancel using the plan switch or renewal management. Purchased service terms and credited points are unaffected.

title: Auto renewal: one plan at a time
body: Authorizing another tier or cycle replaces the old setting. Check the cycle, amount and payment method in the confirmation dialog.

title: Same-plan renewal extends the service term
body: Points arrive after payment and service extends from the existing expiry. Matching renewal authorization remains, with the next charge deferred.

title: Upgrade: immediate higher tier, remaining lower-tier time retained
body: Purchase the higher tier at full price, without prorating the difference. Unused lower-tier service time is paused and resumed according to the schedule.

title: Downgrade: immediate points, scheduled service
body: New points arrive after payment. Lower-tier service starts after current and retained terms; it does not immediately replace higher-tier benefits.

title: Changing plan or cycle requires reviewing auto renewal
body: A manual purchase of a different tier or cycle cancels the old auto renewal setting. Confirm authorization again to continue auto renewal.
